_about: Public list prices only, for Val's cost counter (files/zingas_money.py). This repo is public: Gerrit's own subscriptions, receipts and amounts live in the vault (money/subscriptions.json), never here. Dollars per million tokens for AI, dollars per GB-month for storage.

nous.name: Nous Portal
nous._note: Model prices are Anthropic's list prices; Nous may charge a little differently. The monthly receipt check corrects the estimate.

anthropic.name: Backup brain (inside Orgo's plan)
anthropic._note: Used only while Nous is down. It runs on Orgo's own AI credits, so it adds nothing to the bill; the line shows that it was used.
